sinopsis.es: El artista irlandés Guggi, moldeado por la amistad, el trauma y un compromiso sin concesiones con su obra, crea pinturas de boles y recipientes despojados de todo contexto. Un retrato paciente de una vida creativa recluida.
sinopsis.en: Irish artist Guggi, shaped by friendship, trauma, and an uncompromising commitment to his work, creates paintings of bowls and vessels stripped of all context. A patient portrait of a withdrawn creative life.
